_comment: Project-level traps. This file WINS over the shipped file, and it exists to prove the D-07 premise: traps are data, so a project can add or correct them with NO rebuild. A later file replaces a tool's whole entry.

parameters.filter: optional name filter. Pass an empty string for all.

traps: Project-level trap: this entry came from TestProject/Config/TurboMCP/Traps.json, not from the plugin, and it took effect without recompiling the plugin.
A trap can be corrected or removed by editing this file alone, which is why D-07 requires traps to be data.
Project-level trap: the reply can be very large, so ask for a few skills at a time.
